Noah: Spawning RC for backpressure mitigation on batching service. RC id: sherpa-mini-5932. Holding a 20m quiet window. Need quick QE + RM ack.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: sherpa-mini-5932 | image: registry.redwood/serve:sha256:ccdd3344 | pinned=true | use `/deploy promote sherpa-mini-5932 --to=canary --traffic=5%` to start.

Priya: Ack. Running fast smoke + regression diff (subset). ETA 7m.

Marco: Infra prechecks: GPU nodes ok, PV mounts validated, autoscaler quotas cleared. KV prefetch scheduled +45s after canary start.

Priya: smoke results: PASS (40 queries). p50 improved ~7ms, no errors. sample: `200 OK` from all canary pods.

Noah: Abort triggers: sustained 3m error rate > 0.7% OR p95 jump > 140ms. Adding rollback snippet here for release notes and runbook.

Marco: Rollback snippet (ops playbook):
```bash
# rollback to last stable
/deploy rollback promo-5932001 --to=stable
# unpin candidate image
/gcr unpin registry.redwood/serve:sha256:ccdd3344
# clear kv prefetch flag if it was set
/k8s patch daemonset batching-service -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"kv-prefetch":"false"}}}}}'
```

OpsBot: Quiet window engaged for 20m. Non-critical alerts suppressed; critical will still page.

Noah: Plan: start 5% canary, watch 10m. If stable ramp to 30% over 12m. RM must sign off at 30% after 20m stable.

deploy-bot: Queued: `/deploy start sherpa-mini-5932 --traffic=5% --kv-warm=true`

Priya: 10m update: 5% canary stable. Running extended regression now. Dash: https://dashboards.internal/rc/5932

Marco: Observability: no CPU/mem anomalies. No error spikes. Telemetry links posted to dashboard.

Noah: Kicking ramp: `/deploy promote sherpa-mini-5932 --to=prod --staged "30%:12m" --tag "sherpa-mini-kv"`

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Promo ID: promo-5932001. Check status: `/deploy status promo-5932001`. Expected finish ts ~5932109200.

Priya: 25m status: 30% steady, synthetic evals show no quality regression. :white_check_mark:

Ruth: RM signoff: Ruth approves staged promo complete. Ready for full lift in next maintenance window; include rollback commands in release notes.

Noah: Publishing release notes: "Batching/backpressure mitigation; KV prefetch enabled; median latency down ~8ms." Scheduling full lift. Thanks team.
